old_caption: The video captures a vibrant fireworks display against a dark night sky. The sequence begins with green fireworks, their sparks radiating outward. As the scene progresses, the display shifts to bursts of red and orange fireworks, creating a dynamic contrast. Smoke fills the sky, obscuring parts of the display and adding to the visual texture.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a vibrant fireworks display against a dark night sky. The sequence begins with a burst of red fireworks, their sparks radiating outward in a dazzling array of light. As the camera pans upward, the scene transitions to a burst of green fireworks, creating a mesmerizing contrast with the red. The camera then shifts focus to a cluster of white fireworks, which explode into a dense cloud of light, momentarily obscuring the view. Following this, a burst of pink fireworks illuminates the sky, adding another layer of color to the spectacle. The final frames show a burst of orange fireworks, their bright hues standing out vividly against the night backdrop. Throughout the video, the camera remains steady, capturing the dynamic and colorful explosions from a fixed position, allowing viewers to fully appreciate the beauty and intensity of the fireworks.
caption: The video captures a fireworks display unfolding against a night sky filled with drifting smoke. A thick green-tinted haze, already lingering from an unseen burst, fills the upper and central frame, scattered with green, blue, white and orange sparks and faint vertical trails at the left, then gradually dims into gray smoke. As the haze clears, a small orange starburst at the lower right expands into a wide multi-point shell with bright green cores, joined by additional gold-and-green bursts blooming across the top and right. A deep red glow swells from the bottom center while several white-headed red ascenders rise, dragging curving spark trails upward through the frame. A tall vertical column of gold fountain sparks builds on the right and keeps lengthening. Sparse individual sparks and short falling trails drift downward throughout the display. Near the close, a utility pole and wire appear briefly at the lower left.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
